title: bamboo knife organizer
text: bamboo knife organizer. Ok.. every time I open my knife drawer - it's literally taking your life in your hands to reach in.  I've had it.  So, I decided to try this.  I provided a before and after pic.  In all fairness, I didn't put every single item back in the drawer, because I didn't need what I had in there anyway.  What is especially nice - it makes the steak knives easy to access, but without stabbing or cutting yourself.  The larger knives should stay sharp longer because each are safely enveloped in their own bamboo sleeve.  It really is easier on my mind to have this organizer.  A small investment for that peace.  It is heavy, but not overly so. It seems well made and sturdy.  Having said all that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
